author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 10 De principio S.S. Theologiae a primo dependente COMPLETE (PHYS 302–mid-323 before Cap. 11).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 10 On the principle of sacred theology dependent on the first, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (PHYS 302–mid-323): dependent principle as Church testimony (pure/mixed) or extra-ecclesial; proof vs declaration; analytic vs dialectic rules; public/private principle (councils, symbols, confessions, private doctors); gentile testimony of Hermes/Sibyls with Casaubon's critique; Cap. 10 close via Eusebius on the Artemonites. Cap. 11 begins PHYS 323; Cap. 9 complete; Liber I continues toward PHYS ~330.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for Liber I Cap. 10 densify complete.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 10 densify COMPLETE, reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS 302–mid-323 before CAPUT UNDECIMUM). Same-page OCR (tesseract lat + Vision) used as check. No modern English was copied. Cap. 11 (CAPUT UNDECIMUM / De S. Theologiae distributione) begins PHYS 323. Cap. 9 complete. Liber I still open toward PHYS ~330. No Internet Archive copy was located.
